CustomField.description:
The date that an former Accelerated account, has to wait until they are eligible for an Accelerated tier again. Set by flow when the Pro Account Cancelled Date is updated on an Account with Type AGP or AGP-Premier. Flow: Account_ProAccountCancelledDateWithTypeAGP_UpdateAcceleratedLockoutPeriodEndDate
S3P-1158 - Created.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If populated, this Account is ineligible to join an accelerated tier until after the date listed.
CustomField.label: Accelerated Lockout Period End Date
